# Retail sales and inventory application

> An offline-capable retail web application for Nigerian businesses. After initial setup and while a local authenticated session remains valid, merchants can record core sales during an outage and synchronize pending work when the service becomes reachable.

## Verified capabilities

- Record sales and sale items.
- Track stock through append-only stock movements.
- Record customer credit and part-payments through a credit movement ledger.
- Generate and share digital receipts.
- Scope staff access by role and branch.
- Support businesses with 1 to 6 branches; consolidated workflows remain subject to pilot validation.

## Important limitations

- Initial setup, authentication, synchronization, refunds, and voids require an internet connection.
- Pending unsynchronized work remains on the device where it was created until synchronization succeeds.
- This website does not publish subscription tiers, prices, trial periods, or free-plan guarantees.
- The application records payment methods as tags; it does not process card or wallet payments.
